headline: Bitcoin Drops to $80,000 Amid Tech Earnings and Fed Inflation Watch
summary: Bitcoin fell 1.4% to around $80,100 following disappointing earnings reports from Samsung and Alphabet. Investors are also monitoring upcoming U.S. inflation and GDP data.
why: Bitcoin is the primary digital currency by market valuation, serving as a key benchmark for sentiment across the broader crypto ecosystem.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Weaker technology earnings dampened risk sentiment, pressuring digital assets.

why_moved: Disappointing mega-cap tech earnings reduced market risk appetite, putting pressure on cryptocurrency valuations ahead of macroeconomic inflation data.
